title: Healthy High Protein English Muffin Meal Prep
description:
Meal Prep Light English Muffins‼️

These are so good, so low calorie, and SO EASY. @goodculture is my all time favorite cottage cheese and makes everything so creamy!

Meal Plans linked in my bio ❤️

🔥Macros for each (makes 20):

~ 129 Calories
~ 8g protein
~ 19g Carbs
~ 1g Fat

Ingredients for 17-20:

 ✅ - 600g Self Rising Flour

 ✅ - 650g Low/non Fat Cottage Cheese

 ✅ - 3 Tbsp Garlic Paste

✅ - 1 Tbsp Salt
